title: DASHit
description: A hyperlocal quick-commerce website for ordering groceries and daily essentials across Anantnag, Kashmir.
challenge: Build a cost-effective hyperlocal delivery platform that could support fast grocery ordering, regional delivery operations, and cross-platform access while minimizing recurring infrastructure costs for maps and related services.
solution: Built a Next.js and Capacitor platform for web, Android, and iOS, powered by Firebase Firestore for real-time order management, OpenStreetMap-based driver tracking, an Open Food Facts product importer, and a comprehensive dark-store admin dashboard for operations.
results: Cross-platform web, Android, and iOS experience delivered
Real-time order management and driver tracking implemented
Admin dashboard for store operations and order processing built
OpenStreetMap integration reduced dependency on paid mapping services
Automated product catalog import workflow integrated
PWA support and SEO foundations implemented with sitemap generation
